spec.title: Feature summary  ·  Drifted features only
spec.description: Shows only features with an active warning or critical drift status; features within limits are excluded. PSI values and active alerts are color-coded by severity.

spec.expr:
((
  label_replace(
    drift_status{feature!="prediction"} == 1,
    "alert",
    "${1} warning",
    "metric",
    "(.+)"
  )

  or

  label_replace(
    drift_status{feature!="prediction"} == 2,
    "alert",
    "${1} critical",
    "metric",
    "(.+)"
  )
)

and on(feature)

(
  drift_status_feature{feature!="prediction"}
  ${status_filter:raw}
))
or
label_replace(
  label_replace(
    drift_report_timestamp_seconds <= 0,
    "feature", "Collecting data", "", ""
  ),
  "alert", "Insufficient data", "", ""
)

label_replace(
  drift_threshold{metric="psi", level="warning"},
  "color", "yellow", "level", "warning"
)
or
label_replace(
  drift_threshold{metric="psi", level="critical"},
  "color", "red", "level", "critical"
)

label_replace(
  drift_threshold{metric="psi", level="warning"},
  "color",
  "yellow",
  "level",
  "warning"
)
or
label_replace(
  drift_threshold{metric="psi", level="critical"},
  "color",
  "red",
  "level",
  "critical"
)
